editor.title: Color versions

chatResultUnknown: The connection was interrupted, so the result could not be confirmed. Check your remaining usage or contact support before sending again.
chatClarifyMessage: Tell me how you would like to select your photos, or what you would like to know.
editorialIndependentDescription: Keep this proposal as a separate editable board. Your original board stays unchanged.

editorialNoSource: This proposal has no source board to merge into. Save it separately instead.
editorialPending: A previous change is unconfirmed. Close review and confirm the previous action.
chatPreferenceNotice: Save for this project. You can correct or remove it in Aesthetic Memory.
chatPreferenceSaved: Saved. Manage it in Aesthetic Memory.
chatPreferenceRemoved: This memory has been updated or deactivated.
chatRecoveryNoResend: This checks the previous analysis without sending your photos again.
chatRecovery_pending: Your previous photo analysis is still processing. Check again shortly.

chatRecovery_unknown: The previous result is still unconfirmed. Check later or contact support.
chatRecovery_rejected: The previous analysis was not accepted. Check your usage before starting again.
